caption:
Its or it's? There's a 2-second test.

Swap in “it is.” If it fits, use it's. If it doesn't, use its: "The company updated its logo."

Save this for test day.
tiktok_caption: Its or it's? There's a 2-second test: swap in “it is.”

youtube.title: Its vs It's on the SAT: The 2-Second Test
youtube.description: It's means it is or it has; its shows possession. The swap-in test tells you which one the sentence needs.
